title: DE-VAE: Revealing Uncertainty in Parametric and Inverse Projections with Variational Autoencoders using Differential Entropy
abstract: arXiv:2508.12145v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recently, autoencoders (AEs) have gained interest for creating parametric and invertible projections of multidimensional data. Parametric projections make it possible to embed new, unseen samples without recalculating the entire projection, while invertible projections allow the synthesis of new data instances. However, existing methods perform poorly when dealing with out-of-distribution samples in either the data or embedding space. Thus, we propose DE-VAE, an uncertainty-aware variational AE using differential entropy (DE) to improve the learned parametric and invertible projections. Given a fixed projection, we train DE-VAE to learn a mapping into 2D space and an inverse mapping back to the original space. We conduct quantitative and qualitative evaluations on four well-known datasets, using UMAP and t-SNE as baseline projection methods. translated_title: DE-VAE：利用差分熵的变分自编码器揭示参数化投影与逆投影中的不确定性
translated_abstract: 近年来，自编码器（AE）在创建多维数据的参数化投影和可逆投影方面备受关注。参数化投影使得无需重新计算整个投影即可嵌入新的、未见过的样本，而可逆投影则允许合成新的数据实例。然而，现有方法在处理数据空间或嵌入空间中的分布外样本时表现不佳。因此，我们提出了DE-VAE，一种利用差分熵（DE）的不确定性感知变分自编码器，以改进学习到的参数化投影和可逆投影。给定一个固定的投影，我们训练DE-VAE学习从原始数据到二维空间的映射，以及从二维空间反向映射回原始空间的逆映射。我们在四个知名数据集上使用UMAP和t-SNE作为基线投影方法进行了定量和定性评估。我们的研究结果表明，DE-VAE能够创建精度可比的参数化投影和逆投影，并能揭示数据中的不确定性。
tldr: 提出了一种利用差分熵来量化不确定性的变分自编码器DE-VAE，有效提升了参数化投影和可逆投影在处理分布外样本时的鲁棒性与可靠性。
en_tdlr: DE-VAE, an uncertainty-aware variational autoencoder leveraging differential entropy, improves parametric and inverse projections of multidimensional data by reliably handling out-of-distribution samples.
